Commentary.Commentary: Time to pose with the trophy! Happy faces everywhere. We are done with this short series. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. Looking forward to your company for future series. Don't forget to join us on Thursday (1st August 2019) at 1100 local (1000 GMT) to catch Day 1 of the biggest rivalry in Test cricket - Ashes! Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Sri Lankan skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne says that they were really good from the start. Mentions that a few new players were tried today and they fared well. Adds that they were planning to do the basics right, for the bowlers to stick to good lines and lengths and for the batsmen to capitalize on the starts. On his captaincy, Karunaratne replies that he is still learning and thanks all the senior and junior guys for supporting him. Tells that they have to switch on to the Test series and are ready for the challenge against New Zealand. Appreciates the crowd for all the support.

Nuwan Kulasekara is given a token of appreciation by Sri Lankan cricket and the ministry of sports. Time for a farewell speech - Kulasekara has a big smile on his face and he is greeted with a big cheer from the crowd. He starts by thanking everyone including his family. Rest of his speech is difficult to understand as it's in his local language.

Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal says that Taijul was a real positive for them in the series but adds that there are a lot of negatives as well including his personal form. Mentions that responsibility is the key and it's disappointing to see that the senior players have not taken it upon themselves. On his form, Tamim replies that he has let himself down starting from the World Cup. Tells that he tried hard but probably he wasn't good enough. Wants to go back, take some time off, work on his game and return strong.

ANGELO MATHEWS IS THE MAN OF THE MATCH AND SERIES! He starts by thanking Kulasekara and calls him a silent hero. He wishes him all the best. Further says that while batting he was looking to build partnerships and is content that he managed to get good totals for his team in the series. Tells that the pitches they played on were quite slow and with bigger boundaries, scoring runs wasn't easy. Adds that he just wanted to stay positive. Feels that each and every player goes through these kinds of phases (talking about his lean patch) and you use your experience and trust your ability to come out of it. Admits that it has been a disappointing few months for the team but is delighted with this series win. Hopes to start fresh from here and he is looking forward to the New Zealand series.
Sri Lankan players are giving Nuwan Kulasekara a guard of honour. An emotional moment for him as he walks in with his wife and kids. As always, Percy is there giving him company.

Dasun Shanaka is caught up for a quick interview. Says that after getting dropped, he worked hard on his game and trained a lot with his coaches which helped him. Dasun tells that he has full confidence in his batting and that helped him in his bowling too. Admits it has been a good day for them and they are happy with the result. Hopes that this series win will help them build momentum for future games.

A completely one-sided match! Sri Lanka posted a big total on the board, mainly due to the onslaught in the last 10 overs by their batsmen. In pursuit, Bangladesh never got going. Leaving alone Soumya Sarkar, the batting meekly surrendered and didn't put up any fight. Taijul Islam had some fun towards the end and reduced the defeat margin with his entertaining knock. Just like their batting, Sri Lanka's bowling was also right on the money. Especially, their pacers were brilliant and picked seven wickets combined. Dasun Shanaka stood out with three wickets and it was a good all-round performance by him as it was his 14-ball 30 knock that provided the much-needed impetus to the Sri Lankan innings in the death overs.

A match dedicated to Nuwan Kulasekara and Sri Lanka have made it a truly memorable one with this convincing victory. Lasith Malinga also got a winning farewell in the first ODI and another servant of Sri Lankan cricket is given a good parting gift.

OUT! Rubel Hossain is run out! SRI LANKA WIN BY 122 RUNS AND TAKE THE SERIES 3-0! A fuller length ball on middle and leg, Taijul helps it off his pads to square leg and calls his partner for a quick run. Rubel responds and in the meantime, Karunaratne fires in a good throw to the keeper. Perera does the rest and catches Rubel short of the crease. The third umpire confirms the same. The Lankan players are delighted and shaking hands in the middle.
Turns it off his pads but finds the backward square leg fielder.
Flatter and on middle, swept fine down the leg side for two.
Front foot defense by Taijul Islam as Hasaranga bowls it full on middle.

FOUR! Desperate dive but still it has gone into the fence. Slog sweep over the head of mid-wicket. The ball is tossed up on off, Taijul goes down on one knee and slogs it over mid-wicket where the fielder dives desperately to his right but cannot save the boundary.
Pitched outside leg, Wanindu bowls the googly. The ball turns towards the stumps and hits the pads of the batsman. The Lankans appeal again. The umpire denies it straightaway.
Floated and on middle, Rubel works it off the inner half of his bat and it rolls through square leg. They take two runs to close a 17-run over.
Quicker and flatter on middle, hit across the line through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! 14 runs in the last 3 balls. Some entertainment for the crowd. Shehan slows this one in the air and serves it full on middle, Taijul again slogs it over mid-wicket and it beats the two fielders behind it to the fence.
FOUR! Innovation this time. Tossed up ball around off, Taijul brings out the reverse sweep and nails it past backward point for a cracking boundary.
SIX! Taijul has decided to have some fun. He goes down on one knee to a full ball around off and slog sweeps it handsomely over mid-wicket. 150 comes up!
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
This time Hossain confidently comes onto the front foot and defends this full ball back to the bowler.
Tossed up and full, Rubel blocks it towards the leg side.

Now, does this one hit the pad first or the bat. The Lankans think it hit the pad. They appeal loudly but the umpire denies it. The replays roll in but the Ball Tracker shows that it would have gone with the umpire's call.
Full, tossed up and just outside the leg pole. The ball turns towards the stumps and hits the pads of Hossain. The Lankans appeal but even they know it is not out.
On the pads of Rubel, he tries to flick it but misses.
Rubel Hossain walks out at number 11.

OUT! No Shafiul is out of his crease and that's why Perera was so confident. Wanindu strikes on his very first ball. Leg spinner pitching on off and it spins away from Shafiul. He looks to have a whack at it but misses. Kusal Perera takes the bails off in a flash. He is confident that he has his man. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs and the replays show Shafiul was outside the crease.
Stumping appeal taken upstairs. Kusal Perera is confident. Let's see if Shafiul is in.
FOUR! Taijul confidently lofts this full ball on off over the head of Kumara towards the long on fence for a boundary.
Again on the pads, maybe Kumara is going for the stumps and hoping the batter would miss it. Taijul just flicks it off the back foot.
On the pads by Kumara, Shafiul clips it towards the leg side and takes a single.
Good length ball bang on middle, Shafiul blocks it off the back foot.
There is surely a noise, but it's maybe just the bat hitting the ground. Yorker bowled just outside the off pole by Kumara, Shafiul tries to jam it out but misses it.
On the pads of Taijul, he clips it towards fine leg for a single.

A nicely flighted ball on off, Shafiul takes it on the full and drills it back past the bowler. Dananjaya goes down low to stop the ball but it misses his right hand and cannons onto the stumps. Akila smiles.
Drinks break. Sri Lanka are just two wickets away from a clean sweep. Only formalities left, let's see how soon it ends. Shafiul Islam is the new batsman out in the centre. Two slips in place.

OUT! Sound of timber! Dananjaya becomes the first spinner to pick a wicket in this run chase. A nicely disguised variation from Akila. This one lands full outside off and spins back in viciously. Sarkar is seen making room on the off side for an expansive drive through the line. But the ball spins back in too much to beat his bat and rattle the stumps. A good fighting knock by Sarkar is over and the end is nigh for Bangladesh.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed off the front foot but straight to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Nicely played! Soumya continues to impress. He jumps out of the crease to a full ball on middle and lofts it beautifully over extra cover for a boundary.
Loopy and on middle, Taijul inside edges his attempted flick shot through backward square leg for one.
Full and flighted on off, Taijul stretches forward and defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Sarkar pounces on this length ball outside off. He just times it beautifully as he cuts this one towards the backward point fence for a boundary.
Good length ball wide outside off, Kumara bowls with a change in his action. Taijul gets down and plays it towards third man for one.
Bouncer again! This time Taijul plays at it but the ball narrowly misses the edge of the bat as it carries through to the keeper.
FOUR! Edgy but will do for Bangladesh. Good length ball wide outside off, Taijul goes for the drive but gets a thick outside edge as the ball races away towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Bouncer bowled at a very good pace, it goes near the head height of Taijul. He leaves it and Kusal Perera collects it with a jump.
Good length ball on off, the ball rushes through towards Sarkar, He guides it towards third man and changes ends.
Flighted delivery on middle, Sarkar flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy delivery on off, Sarkar keeps it out.
Floated delivery on off, Sarkar drives it back towards the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Sarkar blocks it off the front foot.
Play and a miss! There was turn on this one. Flighted delivery just outside off, Sarkar looks to play a reverse sweep but misses it completely. The ball was inches away from the off stump.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Islam lofts it over mid-wicket. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it. The batsmen get three runs.
Short and pulled away by Islam, the ball goes uppishly towards deep backward square leg. The fielder from deep fine leg cuts it off as the batters take a single.
Again similar line and length, Islam manages to put bat on ball as he blocks it out.
Length ball on off, Taijul goes hesitantly onto the back foot and hits it towards mid off.
Again bowls it short of a length on leg, the ball angles away from Sarkar as he guides it towards third man and takes a single.
Short of a length ball but stays low, Sarkar is way too early into his pull shot and fails to connect with the ball again.
Bouncer! Kumara hits the deck hard and the ball bounces high and rapidly. Sarkar tries to cut this one but misses as the ball carries through to the keeper.
Tossed up on off, Sarkar plays it towards covers for a run.

APPEAL FOR CAUGHT BEHIND! NOT OUT! Flighted delivery on leg, Sarkar looks to flick but misses it and gets it off the pads. It goes towards Kusal Perera who takes the catch and appeals for caught behind but the umpire shakes his head. There was no bat on it.
Short and outside off, Sarkar cuts it to point.
Flighted delivery on off, Taijul punches it towards point for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Islam flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Flighted delivery on off, Sarkar comes down the track and hits it through covers for a run.
Akila Dananjaya is back into the attack.
Again length ball on off, Taijul again defends it off the back foot, this time towards mid off.
Length ball on off, Taijul Islam pushes it towards the off side.
Taijul Islam is the next man in.

OUT! Caught! Bangladesh lose their seventh wicket. Kumara bowls this one on off pole, the ball keeps rising on the batter. He misjudges the pace of the ball horribly and closes the face of the bat way too soon as he tries to push this one on the leg side. The ball takes the leading edge of Hasan's bat and lobs up towards Dhananjaya de Silva (sub) at covers. He takes some time to settle himself under it and takes an easy catch.
Lasith Malinga is also in attendance. He is there to support his old mate Nuwan Kulasekara who is also retiring. This third ODI is dedicated to Nuwan, in case you don't know.
Kumara runs in and hits the deck hard. The ball rises short and on the leg side, Mehedi lets it go to the keeper.
Yorker wide outside the off stump of Sarkar, he bends down and guides it towards third man for a single.
On the hips of Sarkar, he glances it towards deep square leg. The batters take a couple.
FOUR! Brilliant late cut. Short and outside off, Mehedi waits and then cuts it late through third man for a boundary.
Floated on off, Mehedi strokes it to cover.
Short around off, Soumya cuts it to point for a single.
On the pads, Soumya flicks it to mid-wicket.
Floated on middle and off, Sarkar defends it off the front foot.
Flighted on middle, Sarkar taps it back to the bowler.
Blocked this full ball towards covers, another good over for the Lankans.

FOUR! Hasan gets off the mark with a boundary and a misfield. Short of a length ball, Hasan punches the ball of the back foot towards third man. The fielder there lets it go underneath him and the ball crosses the fence.
Mehedi Hasan walks out to bat next.

OUT! What a catch! Substitute Dhananjaya de Silva has taken a blinder here! Good length ball on off, Sabbir looks to drive the ball on the up but he ends up hitting it uppishly. It goes to the left of substitute, Dhananjay de Silva at cover. He dives to his left and takes an absolute stunner. The crowd are up in joy and why won't they be? Everything has been brilliant from Sri Lanka in this series. 190 needed off 152 balls now.
Similar line and length, Rahman blocks it out.
Length ball on off, the ball is bumped into the ground and the ball goes to Kusal Perera.
Full length ball on off, Sarkar drives at it but gets the inside half of it. The ball rolls towards fine leg and they take a single.
Lahiru Kumara is into the attack.
This time punched straight to cover. Dot ball to end the over.
Short outside off, Sabbir punches it to cover-point and gets a couple.
On off, Sarkar defends it with soft hands towards cover and rotates the strike.
Floated on off, Sabbir strokes it to cover for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Sabbir defends it off the front foot.

Fifty for Soumya Sarkar. He has batted well and will look to convert this into a big one. Shorter on off, Soumya punches it to sweeper cover and gets a single to bring up his 11th ODI fifty. Also it brings up the 100 for Bangladesh.
Wanindu Hasaranga is into the attack.
Short and flat outside off, Rahman blocks it out. A good over for Sri Lanka comes to an end.
Shorter in length to Sarkar, he goes onto the back foot and cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Tossed up full on off, Sabbir plays it towards long off and takes a run to put Sarkar on strike.

He has gloved it and hence the decision has to be reversed. Good review this from Sabbir. Flighted ball on middle and leg, Sabbir looks to sweep but misses. Sri Lankan players put in a loud and confident appeal. The umpire agrees and raises his finger. Sabbir though takes it upstairs straightaway as if he knows he has got something on it. Replays roll in and the Ultra Edge shows big spike as the ball goes past his gloves. Very good review from Sabbir. He survives to fight another day.
Sabbir Rahman has been adjudged LBW but he has taken the review straightaway suggesting he has got something on it. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Full ball tossed on off, Sarkar plays it down to long off for a single.
Floated on off, Sarkar strokes it to cover. There is a misfield there but no run taken.
Length ball but outside off, Sarkar cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Short and on leg side by Shanaka, Sarkar ducks and lets it go through to the keeper.
Rahman pulls this one but gets just the inner half of the bat on it, Sarkar calls for a run and they scamper through.
Length ball on off, Rahman plays it towards point.
Full ball wide outside off, Sarkar gets underneath it and plays it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Good length ball on off, but Sarkar is the only Bangladeshi batsman who is looking in good touch here. He gets on top of the bounce and cuts this one towards cover point for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Sabbir nudges it to mid off.
Shorter on off, SS punches it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Uppish but safe. Floated on off, Sabbir looks to sweep but gets a top edge which falls in no man's land at square leg for a single.
Flighted on off, Sabbir looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Tossed up on off, Sabbir strokes it to mid off.
Floated on off, Sarkar strokes it to long off for a single.
On the pads of Sarkar, he plays it wide of mid on and keeps the strike as he takes a single.
Wide! Shanaka bangs it in short, Sarkar lets it go through to the keeper. The ball is too high and the umpire signals wide.
This one is right on middle and off pole, Rahman gets off the mark as he flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Sabbir Rahman is the new man in for Bangladesh.

OUT! Caught! Bangladesh are five down now. Shanaka bowls this one on a length and on the fourth stump line. It pitches and nips away from the batsman. Mahmudullah plays at it but just inside the line of the delivery. He gets an outside edge on it and the ball goes wide to the right of Kusal Perera as he dives and takes a good catch. Things going from bad to worse for the Tigers.
Fuller this time by Shanaka, Sarkar flicks it wide off mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Graceful! This one is bowled on length by Shanaka, Sarkar comes down the track and just lofts it over the bowler for a boundary. Beautiful batting by Sarkar.
Good length ball just outside off, Mahmudullah guides it towards third man and takes a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Sarkar blocks it to see through the over.
Floated on middle, Mahmudullah nudges it to long on for one.
On the pads, Mahmudullah turns it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flighted on the stumps, Mahmudullah defends it off the front foot.
Sarkar comes down the track and looks to hit it straight but the ball spins in taking the inside edge of the bat. It goes to fine leg for a single.
Floated on the stumps, Mahmudullah strokes it to long on for one.
Sri Lanka on the attack. A slip in place along with a backward short leg fielder.
Full ball on middle and leg pole, Mahmudullah pushes it softly towards mid-wicket and takes a single to keep the strike.
Length ball way outside off, Mahmudullah lets it go through to the keeper.
Pitched full and outside the off pole. Mahmudullah blocks it out off  the front foot.
Again full on off, this time Sarkar plays it further away from the fielder and takes a single.
Full ball on off, punched towards cover.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Soumya Sarkar cuts it beautifully square of the wicket towards the cover-point fence for a boundary.

Drinks Break! Sri Lanka are on track for 3-0 here after removing the cream of Bangladesh's batting. The hosts have been on the money right from the start and never allowed the visitors to get going. The Bangla Tigers need a big stand here to roar back in this match but from the look of things, it seems unlikely. 227 more needed off 33 overs with 6 wickets in hand.
Short on off, this is an off spinner now. Sarkar punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
BEAUTY! Wrong 'un from Dananjaya. It is just outside off, Soumya does not pick it early and looks to go over on the off side. He misses and the ball misses the outside edge by just a whisker.
Once again short, Sarkar cuts it hard but finds point.
Shorter on off, Mahmudullah this time cuts it towards point and gets a single.

UNDER EDGE AND FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Mahmudullah looks to cut but it goes off the under edge and through the gap between first slip and the keeper for a boundary. The slip fielder there reacted to his right but the ball sneaked past his left side.
Floated on middle, Soumya strokes it to long on for a single.
Full ball on off, blocked straight back towards the bowler by Mahmudullah.

Loud appeal by Sri Lanka but it's pitching outside leg to the naked eye. The replays come in and confirm that the ball has pitched outside leg. It hits the pad of Sarkar and the ball rolls towards mid-wicket as the batters cross for a leg bye.
Mahmudullah walks out to bat next.

OUT! Oh...Ohh...and it's caught! Bangladesh in deep trouble now as Mithun departs. Lahiru Kumara having a bit of fun here too. This is a short of a length ball, Mithun looks to pull it powerfully across the line but mistimes it. The ball goes high and Lahiru moves across to his left from fine leg to catch the ball while juggling a bit. Sri Lanka are all smiles now with Bangladesh needing a big partnership to revive some hope.
Length ball on off, played to covers for one.
Swing and a miss! Short and on off, Mithun looks to pull this one. He swings his bat but misjudges the bounce as the ball goes over the bat.
On the leg side, Sarkar pulls it towards deep fine leg for one.
Fires one in, full and on middle, it's clipped through mid-wicket for a single. 10 from the over!

SIX! High and handsome! Great footwork shown by Sarkar. There was an element of risk there as it was an off break by Dananjaya. But Sarkar is down to the pitch of the ball in a flash and launches it over the bowler's head.
Slower through the air, the length is a bit short and around off, Mithun goes deep inside the crease and forces it down to long on for one.
Quicker one, full and on off, Sarkar pushes it in the gap at covers and rushes to the other end.
Turning in from outside off, Mithun works it to square leg for a run. 50 up for Bangladesh.
Mixing it up, Akila. A leg break this time, flat and on middle, staying a bit low as well, Mithun does well to defend it on the leg side.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Around off, Sarkar gets forward and plays it down with an angled bat to cover-point.
Shanaka this time is on the shorter side around middle, Mithun pulls it behind square leg and takes a run.
Good bowling from Shanaka. Maintaining a good line here. Lands this one on a good length close to off stump, Mithun plays it down from the crease towards cover-point.
Slower than the last delivery, on a good length and cutting back in, Mithun shows a straight bat in defense and keeps it out off the inner half.
Fuller in length and around off, angling in, Mithun brings his bat down and pushes it out to mid on.
Loopy and on middle, Sarkar gets back and works it to mid-wicket. A good over to follow-up the last over.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it back to the bowler.

Spinning back in from around off, some extra bounce too, Mithun gets forward to defend with his bat and pad together. It takes the inside edge and rolls behind square leg for one. Streaky way to get off the mark.
Full and flighted around off, Sarkar drives it through covers and takes a run.
Tossed up ball outside off, Sarkar covers his sticks and leaves it alone.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it watchfully.

OUT! Big, big wicket for Sri Lanka! Bangladesh's best batsman is out of here. Cross-seam delivery outside off, Mushfiqur throws his bat at it and ends up getting a thick outside edge to first slip. Kusal Mendis at first slip takes an easy catch. Shanaka is up in joy and so is the whole crowd here. Mushfiqur was the key in this chase and he is gone. Body blow to Bangladesh. 249 needed off 228 balls. Mohammad Mithun will replace him out in the middle.
Full on off, Rahim strokes it to mid off.
On the pads, Sarkar flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Mushfiqur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Shanaka bowls it way outside off. On the wrong side of the tramline and it has been wided.
Committed effort in the field! Good length ball around off, Mushfiqur taps it towards backward point. Kusal Mendis runs to his right and puts in a dive to save runs for his side.
Shanaka starts with a good length ball outside off, Mushfiqur watches it carry to the keeper.
Dasun Shanaka is into the attack.
On the pads, Mushfiqur  turns it behind square on the leg side for one.
Flighted on off, Mushfiqur blocks it away.

Very good running. Flighted delivery on off, Sarkar defends it with soft hands towards cover and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but ends up hitting the calf of Sarkar.
Slower through the air on the stumps, Sarkar blocks it.
Floated on the stumps, Soumya defends it with a straight bat.
Starts with a flighted delivery on middle, Sarkar defends it off the front foot.
Akila Dananjaya to begin Powerplay 2.
Powerplay 2 time. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Good length ball on off, Mushfiqur defends it off the front foot.

That is a beauty from Rajitha! Very full ball on off, Rahim looks to play it across the line but there is late swing on it which makes the ball miss the edge of the bat and the off pole by just mere inches.
Back of a length ball on off, Mushfiqur pulls it but cannot get it past mid-wicket.
WIDE! But a very good take from Perera behind the stumps. Full down the leg side, Mushfiqur looks to flick but misses. Kusal dives to his left and saves it from going for five wides.
Full on off, Mushfiqur drives it off the meat but straight to cover.
On the pads, Sarkar flicks it to the on side for a single.
OHH! Good length ball outside off, it comes in with the angle. Sarkar looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short and outside off, Rahim makes room and cuts it hard through point for a boundary. 10 runs have come from the over. Good one for Bangladesh.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Rahim flicks it towards fine leg. The fielder chases the ball and does well to stop it. The batsmen get two runs.
Loopy delivery on off, Sarkar plays it towards covers for a quick single.
Floated delivery on middle, Rahim flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Sarkar flicks it towards square leg. The batsmen take a run.
Tossed up on middle, Rahim flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new batsman in. He has been Bangladesh's best batsman in this series.

OUT! Rajitha has the last laugh! He bowls it full and on the pads, Anamul tries to be over aggressive and once again goes to attack. He  looks to flick but gets a top  edge on it. It goes towards backward square leg. Avishka Fernando runs from mid-wicket and takes a brilliant catch with a slide. Both the wickets have fallen to Kasun Rajitha and Bangladesh are in a spot of bother.
FOUR! One brings two and that is what has happened here. Rajitha over-corrects himself and bowls a short ball. Haque was expecting it and he pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

FOUR! First boundary of the chase and it has come in the 8th over. That is an indication of how tough things have been out in the middle. Full on off,  Anamul flicks it through mid-wicket to fetch himself a boundary.
On top of off, Anamul defends it off the front foot.
In the air but safe. Full outside off, Sarkar looks to go over mid off but gets a top edge on it. Luckily it falls wide and short of third man. Single taken.
On the pads, Anamul looks to flick but the ball goes off his thigh pad and they take a leg bye.
Fuller on middle, Anamul milks it down to long on for one.
Flights it around off, Sarkar strokes it towards mid off and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Even if he had hit, Sarkar would have been safe.
On middle, Anamul glances it to mid-wicket for a single.
Play and a miss! Short and straight outside off, Anamul looks to cut but misses.
Flighted around off, Anamul taps it back to the bowler.
Floated on the pads, Soumya glances it to square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, Anamul tucks it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball around off, Sarkar runs it down to third man for a single.
Now bowls it closer to the off pole and Soumya defends it with a straight bat.
WIDE! Another one on the wrong side of the tramline and Soumya has no business with it. Wide signalled.
WIDE! Rajitha bowls it way outside off. Sarkar lets it be and it has been wided.
Length ball around off, Sarkar strokes it to mid off.
Fuller on off, Sarkar pushes it to mid off.

Oh! Short ball down the leg side, Sarkar looks to pull but misses. It is not far away from the glove. Perera behind the stumps moves to his right and takes it on the full. Kusal goes up in appeal but nothing from the umpire.
This time Anamul sweeps but finds square leg.
Tossed up on off, Anamul defends it to point.

Appeal for an LBW but turned down by the umpire. Flighted outside off, Anamul looks to play the sweep but misses and the ball hits him on the pads. There is a confident appeal from the bowler but the umpire says no. Impact seemed to be an issue there.
On the pads, Haque flicks it but finds short mid-wicket.
Over the top. Floated outside off, Sarkar lofts it over cover. Kusal Mendis, Akila Dananjaya and Hasaranga all go after the ball. It is Akila who stops it with a dive. Three runs taken.
Floated on off, Anamul milks it towards long on for a single.
Full on off, Anamul strokes it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single. Just two runs off the over.
Fuller on the stumps, AH defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, Anamul defends it to cover.
Another beauty! Good length ball outside off, the ball zips away after pitching. Anamul looks to defend but misses and the ball goes past the outside edge.

Almost chopped on! Good length ball around off, Sarkar looks to play it on the off side with a slanted bat. The ball though comes in and he ends up getting an inside edge which goes past the stumps towards square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle, Sarkar strokes it to mid on.
Shorter on off, Anamul blocks it.
On the pads, Soumya flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Sarkar drives it straight to cover.
On the stumps, Soumya defends it off the front foot.
Beauty! Flighted delivery on off, it spins away after pitching. Sarkar looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge by just a whisker.
Floated on off, Sarkar blocks it off the front foot.
Outside off, Anamul leaves it alone. Top first over by Rajitha, one run and a big wicket from it!
Sarkar is off the mark. Fuller on off, Soumya strokes it towards cover for a single.

Inside edge has saved Soumya from getting a golden duck. Length ball pitching on off, it comes back in after pitching. It looks like Sarkar has been hit right on the pads. The Lankan players put in an appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Dimuth thinks of the review but opts against it after his bowler didn't look too sure. It is a good decision as the replays later on show that there was a big inside edge.
Soumya Sarkar is the next batsman in.

OUT! Tamim's poor run of form continues. Good length ball outside off, this one moves away just a hint. It moves enough to trouble the batsman. Tamim goes chasing after it and he ends up getting a thick outside edge straight to the keeper. Bangladesh needed Tamim to fire but he has failed and this is an early setback for the visitors. Bowled in the first two games and now a caught behind for Tamim in the series. A forgetful one for the stand-in skipper. The Lankan players are delighted and why wouldn't they be? First blood drawn.
This one nips back in just a bit. Tamim defends it off the upper half of his bat towards mid-wicket.
Rajitha starts with a good length ball on middle and off, Tamim pushes it to mid on.
Kasun Rajitha to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
On the pads, Tamim glances it to the on side and keeps the strike. 4 off the first over.
Floated on middle and leg, Anamul strokes it wide of mid on for one.
Flatter and quicker just outside off, Anamul looks to run it down but it stays in front of the stumps off the inner half of his bat.
Tamim is off the mark! On the pads, Tamim flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Comes round the wicket and targets the off pole. It is slightly shorter on off, Tamim defends it off the front foot.
Shehan starts with a tossed up ball on middle and off, Anamul flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets the run chase off the mark with a single.

We are back for the chase! Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal has a new partner in Anamul Haque to open the innings. Sri Lanka, as expected, are starting with a spinner. Shehan Jayasuriya to take the first new ball. One slip in place...
